episode_title: FF5 #114 - Private Assets Decision and the ERISA 3(38) Manager

real_qa.q: How does an ERISA 3(38) investment manager allow plan committees to retain control over private assets decisions?
real_qa.r: A well-written investment policy statement serves as the bridge that gives the committee control. The committee can write an investment policy statement that either allows or does not permit private assets as part of the 401k plan, and this language generally describes the plan's approach to private assets regardless of the discretionary manager's structure.

real_qa.q: What role does the investment policy statement play in addressing private assets in ERISA retirement plans?
real_qa.r: The investment policy statement is critical for determining whether or not private assets can or should be included in any underlying investments. A well-written investment policy statement provides good direction and structure with some flexibility, such as language stating the plan will not generally include private assets as part of the funds in the plan lineup.
real_qa.requete: investment policy statement private assets ERISA

real_qa.q: Can a plan sponsor avoid private assets exposure if they hire a discretionary 3(38) investment manager?
real_qa.r: Yes, the committee still remains in the driver's seat. However, this depends on the investment manager's model—if a particular firm's discretionary 3(38) manager model requires giving them choice over private assets, that advisory firm may not be the right fit if the committee wants to retain that control. The key is selecting an advisor who respects the committee's preferences.

real_qa.q: How should plan committees evaluate advisor selection regarding private assets and default investment alternatives?
real_qa.r: During advisor searches, committees should ask whether the advisor will choose the type of Qualified Default Investment Alternative (QDIA) or whether that choice remains with the committee. This parallel question helps evaluate whether the advisor respects the committee's fiduciary control, which should also apply to private assets decisions.
real_qa.requete: QDIA Qualified Default Investment Alternative advisor selection
